intro: Our project work covers the Appalachian, Gulf Coast, Permian and Michigan basins and the Pacific Northwest. It runs from Marcellus and Utica leasing in Pennsylvania and Ohio to deep gas in northwest Louisiana and East Texas, and solar siting in eastern Washington.
states_note: These are the states where we have already worked files. We take work in any state.

states_served.note: Utica Shale, Appalachian Basin, Clinton/Medina formations
Chattanooga Shale, southern Appalachian Basin, conventional plays
Permian Basin, Eagle Ford Shale, Haynesville/Bossier (East Texas), East Texas Basin
Haynesville Shale, Tuscaloosa Marine Shale, onshore Gulf Coast parishes
Tuscaloosa Marine Shale, southwest counties, Gulf Coast salt-dome trend
Michigan Basin, Antrim Shale, Northern Michigan plays
Solar and renewable energy land acquisition, right-of-way

page_subtitle: Files worked in eight states since 2005, from single tracts to multi-county programs.
